messages:
Ajay Kapoor: Quick handoff note — LumenAI VIP scheduled load run next Tue 09:00 PDT. Im on call until 08:30, then Tess will pick up. This is not an incident, just a watch + FYI on a few risks.
Maria Chen: Thanks Ajay. Key items?
Ajay Kapoor: TL;DR: expected peak qps ~1200, bursty prefix patterns, customer needs 99.9% request success and <300ms p50 for short prompts. Theyre on a Dedicated trial but we didnt finish the reserved pool sizing; fallback policy should route to hosted small-model variant if capacity gets tight.
Tess Romero: @Ajay can you drop the runbook steps (health checks + alert thresholds) here? Ill take over at 08:30 and shadow for the first 30m. :+1:
Ajay Kapoor: Paste of quick runbook snippet — two checks to run before the test and alert thresholds to bump during test:
```
# health check
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.example/v1/models/lumen-std/health

# top-line metrics to watch (Cloudwatch/Prometheus)
redwood.request_success_rate < 99.5%  -> page oncall
redwood.p50_latency > 300ms -> page pg-plat
redwood.p95_latency > 800ms -> warn in-thread
```
Alerting: set temporary escalation to "pg-plat" at 5m instead of 15m.
Samir Patel: Wheres the customer contact? Need phone and Slack channel.
Ajay Kapoor: Claire from CSM owns POC. lumen-sre is in this thread — theyll be running the load. Claire Huang: Yep — SRE contact is @lumen-sre (Ivan). Phone: +1-415-555-0123. Well be on their Zoom + my CS bridge.
lumen-sre: Ivan here. Test plan: 09:00 ramp 0->500 qps in 5m, hold 10m, ramp to 1200 over 10m, hold 15m, then steady 10m. Were doing a few different prompt lengths (short/long). Will report per-minute peaks.
Tess Romero: OK noted. My plan: watch routing table, evict cache flags if we see backend thrash, and keep canary at 3% traffic to lumen-std-canary. If canary errors >1% for 2 consecutive mins Ill flip to fallback.
Ajay Kapoor: Can we pre-seed KV caches for the short prompt pattern? That will lower tail latency. I can do a small preload script at 07:45.
Samir Patel: Ill raise temporary capacity quotas on Dedicated for the window (requesting +50% headroom). If that fails, fallback to hosted-b1 with quantized profile.
Oncall Bot: deploy-bot initiated a scheduled change: Canary route config update scheduled for 2024-04-23T07:55:00Z by Tess Romero.
Tess Romero: Ill be online starting 08:30 PDT. After handoff: immediate checklist: 1) confirm quota bump in billing UI, 2) verify canary route in console, 3) watch redwood.request_success_rate and p50/p95 charts, 4) keep #lumen-bridge Slack open.
Claire Huang: CSM will post run updates every 5m to #lumen-bridge and call out any customer-impacting errors. Please escalate via phone if we hit the 99.9% contract threshold.
Ajay Kapoor: One more risk: ACL config change from this morning removed one of the Dedicated nodes from allowed list for Lumen. I reverted, but keep an eye on auth errors (403). If you see auth spikes, patch is in PR #2384 — quick revert is available.
Tess Romero: Copy. @Samir can you keep the revert ready in case?
Samir Patel: Revert branch ready and tested locally. If auth 403 > 0.5% for 3m Ill trigger it.
Maria Chen: Small note — post-test we should run audit for token usage; Lumen is on high-rate keys and we want to confirm we didnt over-bill.
Ajay Kapoor: Thanks all. Tess, @lumen-sre, Claire — youre on point after 08:30. Ill stay reachable until then. Tagging the watch channel: @pg-plat, @infra-ops :eyes:
Tess Romero: Got it. See you all in thread/bridge.
deploy-bot: deploy complete: route change applied to lumen-std-canary by Tess Romero at 2024-04-23T07:56:12Z :rocket:
Tess Romero: Handoff complete. Starting watch.
